scope.name: Original 62-image story-art catalog after 25 replacements
scope.included: Exactly the original eight base scenes, 32 camera angles and 22 narrative beat artworks, with 25 accepted versioned substitutions.
scope.excluded: Additional per-cut overrides in story-cut-art.json, concurrently generated or modified story/scenes images, historical non-catalog images, and all other site artwork. Soundtrack covers are linked and checked separately.

reference.visualBasis: Solid red disk; two long equal-width straight white horizontal bars joined by central stem; straight white lower diagonals cut through the disk boundary.

criteria.existing_reference_geometry: At least one clearly recognizable straight-bar/stem/edge-cut-diagonal emblem in the artwork. Perspective, scene lighting, wear and reversed color polarity are accepted; exact pixels are not claimed.
criteria.generic_or_inaccurate: Visible branding is a font-like or geometrically inaccurate glyph; a qualifying supplied geometric emblem is not clearly established.
criteria.no_mark: No recognizable SORA emblem is visible in the inspected whole artwork.

method.identity: Read all current 62 PNGs and supplied emblem; compute SHA-256, dimensions and PNG color type. Recheck all identities after processing, including the 25 preserved original assets.
method.unchangedVisualEvidence: Carry forward prior individual visual acceptance only when exact identity matches.
method.replacementVisualEvidence: Match current bytes to accepted generation provenance and root visual acceptance in the replacement map. No new whole-set visual inspection claimed by consolidation.
method.catalogReferences: Imported STORY_SCENES, STORY_ANGLE_ART and STORY_BEAT_ART through local tsx with cache disabled; required exact equality to all 62 expected paths.
method.runtimeScope: Verifies catalog references, not current per-cut override selection or all rendered scenes.

separateSoundtrackCoverEvidence.scope: Separate collection, excluded from 62 story images. Fresh identity verification carries forward the linked visual review; no new cover visual inspection claimed.

outsideScopeKnownWork.meaning: Separate snapshot found 13 additional per-cut images without a mark. They are being worked on concurrently. This audit does not reclassify or certify their current state, nor claim all site artwork complete.

limitations.detail: Accepted image hash and visual review are recorded, but the exact generation prompt and generated-source path were not recovered.

limitations: Natural perspective, lighting, reversed colours and painterly rendering are accepted; exact logo pixels and every secondary tiny glyph are not certified.
Some generation records say runtimeIntegrated=false because they predate integration. The current imported catalog and later root replacement map provide integration evidence.
Rejected boardroom-key-offer attempts remain historical in cutscene-logo-beats-v4.json; accepted asset provenance is the later cutscene-logo-key-offer-v4.json.
